issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change; Livewire definition of done requires happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call and tamper tests for each action.
issues.location: tests/ (absent — change.diff contains no *Test.php or tests/**)

issues.explanation: Settings input properties lack #[Validate] required by Livewire rule 1; save()/transfer() still validate and authorize server-side so no exploitable flaw, but the policy checklist item is not met.
Settings public $name/$slug/$targetMembershipId have no #[Validate] and Members::assignRole uses Validator::make instead of the project pattern #[Validate] + $this->validate().
Domain writes (addMember/assignRole/removeMember/save/delete/transfer) are implemented directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* classes authorizing inside the action.
Wrong generic in PHPDoc: BelongsToMany<User> should be BelongsToMany<Entity>; runtime code is correct.

conventions.evidence: Follows much: Gate::policy registration AppServiceProvider.php:46-47, $fillable, reversible down() migrations, Log::channel('audit') per logging rule, docs/database-schema.md + CHANGELOG.md updated. Deviations: no app/Actions/* for domain writes; Settings $name/$slug/$targetMembershipId lack #[Validate]; Members assignRole uses Validator::make (Members.php:147-149) not #[Validate]+validate().

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/*.php, app/Models/*.php, app/Policies/*.php: clear names, small focused methods, consistent style, {{ }} escaping, no dead code; only nit is User.php:468 generic.

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_073112: slug unique entities_slug_unique + softDeletes; ..._073115: FK cascade, role default employee, unique entity_memberships_entity_user_unique, owner_seq storedAs + unique entity_memberships_one_owner; Entity.php:27 getRouteKeyName slug + memberships/users/owner; UserRole.php:manageable; EntityPolicy.php + EntityMembershipPolicy.php match task matrix; EntityController.php:30-46 pick 403/session untouched/audit/redirect dashboard; Dashboard/Members/Settings mount authorize view/manageSettings; dashboard.blade.php @can manageSettings gates owner notice + settings URL; members assignRole in:admin,employee + owner abort + last-manager abort; settings save unique-ignore, delete soft-delete + memberships delete + session clear, transfer admin-only non-self transaction + redirect; routes/web.php:1076-1079 names/paths; lang/en+pt_BR ui.php nav_members/nav_settings and quoted texts.

scope.evidence: All hunks serve task.md (models, migrations, policies, picker, Livewire pages, routes, lang, database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md); no onboarding/switcher/middleware/navbar/billing/invitations/restore changes.

security.evidence: Every Livewire action re-resolves scoped model (entity->memberships()->findOrFail, Entity::findOrFail) and calls authorize (view/update/assignRole/delete/manageSettings); #[Locked] Entity in Dashboard.php:67-68, Members.php:105-106, Settings.php:215-216; scoped transfer checks + transaction + locks Settings.php:275-291; validation exists (email exists:users,email, in:admin,employee, Rule::unique ignore). Gap: Settings $name/$slug/$targetMembershipId lack #[Validate] (rule 1) though validated before persist.

simplicity.evidence: Lean direct Eloquent + policies + Gate, no service/repository layers, no speculative abstractions or duplication; e.g. membershipFor(), owner() HasOne->owner(), scoped findOrFail + authorize pattern reused.

tests.evidence: change.diff has no tests/**, no *Test.php, no Pest coverage for models/policies/picker/dashboard/members/settings, including required unauthorized-call and tamper tests.

review.summary: Implements the full entity data model, single-owner DB guard, policies, picker, and Livewire dashboard/members/settings pages per contract. Withheld approval because it ships zero tests and misses the #[Validate] attribute pattern on Settings inputs (and the Actions layer), though authorization, scoping, and validation logic are otherwise sound.
